# `aitbc governance profile init`

Create or fetch a DAO governance profile (POST /v1/governance/profiles, admin).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance profile init [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--user-id` | text | — | yes | User ID (JWT sub or wallet address) the profile belongs to |
| `--voting-power` | float | `0.0` | no | Initial voting power (admin only; ignored when the profile already exists) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance profile init --user-id <user_id>
```
